title: Foreign Worker Representation in Tech and IT Sector
what_it_is: Foreign Worker Representation in Tech and IT Sector

sections.label: ICT manpower shortage and plan
sections.summary: IDA estimated a 15,000 ICT professional shortage in 2014 and another 15,000 specialists by 2017, with IDA and industry formulating a Sectoral Manpower Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: The Infocomm Development Authority of Singapore (IDA) estimated that in 2014, there was a shortage of about 15,000 ICT professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: With the rapid advancement and widespread adoption of technology in Singapore's push to become a Smart Nation, further demand for ICT manpower will continue to be strong both in terms of numbers and the range of skills and expertise needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: IDA estimates that by 2017, another 15,000 specialists may be required, especially in growth areas such as software and application development, network and infrastructure, cyber security and data analytics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: To help more Singaporeans benefit from the growth of career opportunities in ICT, IDA and the industry are working together to formulate the Sectoral Manpower Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Our objectives are to (a) sustain the global competitiveness of the sector; (b) achieve manpower-lean growth; (c) develop a strong Singaporean Core; and lastly (d) to foster a highly-skilled and complementary foreign workforce.

sections.label: MOM action against double weak companies
sections.summary: MOM has initiated action against "double weak" companies, an on-going process to ensure Singaporeans get fair consideration in recruitment, development and career enhancement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In fact, MOM has already initiated action against the "double weak" companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: As I had mentioned, this will be an on-going process to ensure that Singaporeans – whether it is ICT sector or all other sectors, whether rank-and-file workers or professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) – will be given fair consideration in recruitment, development and career enhancement.

sections.label: Double weak and double strong companies
sections.summary: There are "double weak" companies on one hand and "double strong" companies on the other.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: On one hand, there are "double weak" companies; on the other, there are also "double strong" companies.
